title: Mere baba khairiat se ho
body:
Mere baba khairiat se ho
Mere baba khairiat se ho
<<DIVIDER>>
(Sughra gash se chownk kar uthi) x2 Boli sar ko pit'ti huwi. (Haye meri nind ur gar ayi) x2
<<MINI>>
Mere baba khairiat se ho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekha aj mene kaisa khwaab. Reyt par pare hai kuch gulab. Chun rahe hai jinko buturab. Khun ro raha hai aftab. Haye meri nind ur gayi
<<MINI>>
(Mere baba khairiat se ho) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik taraf alam hai khun me tar. Juk gayi hai shah ki kamar. Jaa rahi hai jis taraf nazar. Bibiya khari hai nang sar. Haye meri nind ur gayi
<<MINI>>
(Mere baba khairiat se ho) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Hay hay kasim-e-jawaan. Bayn kar rahi hai jiski maa. Hil gayi zamin or asman. Tori jab dulhan ne churiya. Haye meri nind ur gayi
<<MINI>>
(Mere baba khairiat se ho) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek bachi sina-e-padar. Dundh ti rahi idhar udhar. Baap so raha tha khak par. Jis ke tan se kat chukaa tha sar. Haye meri nind ur gayi
<<MINI>>
(Mere baba khairiat se ho) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Kayd hai rasul-e-zadiya. Hath me bandhe hai rassiya. Bekajaawa hai amaariya. Khun ro raha sarebaa(n). Haye meri nind ur gayi
<<MINI>>
(Mere baba khairiat se ho) x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Khwab ye bara ajeeb tha. Badshah dee(n) gharib tha. Kya yahi mera nasib tha. Bekafan mera tabib tha. Haye meri nind ur gayi
<<MINI>>
(Mere baba khairiat se ho) x4
